## Meaning and boundaries of the predicted class

- The predicted class is `outer_race`, the frozen classifier output for this invocation, not a diagnosis of cause.
- The scenario cause, external vibration during standstill, is an independent teaching assumption and cannot be inferred from the classifier output.
- This does not establish that all outer-race faults have this mechanism or that any specific sample experienced these conditions [EV-K01-001].

## Missing information

Actual damage morphology, vibration source/amplitude/duration, lubrication, load, model, mounting fit, maintenance history and aviation applicability are unknown and cannot be determined from the supplied information.

## Limitations

- No occurrence probability or vibration-amplitude/duration threshold is supplied. A location label cannot establish a cause [EV-K01-002].
- This answer is for generic bearing education only, not model-specific maintenance, actual fault identification, aviation applicability, equipment safety or release decisions.
- The evidence supports only these general associations. It is insufficient to determine whether this sample actually has false brinelling or what caused it.
